dialogue.text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Just so you know, I'm an AI assistant and this call is recorded for quality. Can you tell me how long these episodes of unrespons
Hi Doctor. Well, each episode lasts about 3 to 4 minutes. They've been happening over the past month or so.

I understand. Are you aware of your surroundings during these episodes, or do you feel confused once they conclude? Also, do you notice any strange feelings or warnings right before an episode starts?

No, I'm not aware of anything during the episodes – I don't remember them at all. But right before they start, I get this weird muddy taste in my mouth, and then afterwards I feel really tired and confused.
Thank you for those details. Have you noticed any tongue biting or loss of bladder control during these episodes? REQUEST TEST: EEG
RESULTS: Electroencephalogram (EEG) shows interictal spikes and sharp waves localized to the temporal lobes, more prominent on the right side.

The EEG results suggest electrical activity in the temporal lobes, which matches the "muddy taste" you described. Have bystanders mentioned any repetitive actions like lip-smacking or hand-fidgeting during these times? REQUEST TEST: MRI_Brain
RESULTS: MRI Brain shows no evidence of mass lesions, infarctions, or structural abnormalities.
